progress.title: Progress
progress.range.subtitle: Showing %@
progress.chart.empty.title: Nothing to chart yet
progress.chart.empty.message: There is no data in this range. Try a longer one.
progress.empty.title: Nothing to show yet
progress.empty.message: Finish a workout or log your weight, and this tab starts filling in.
progress.training.title: Training
progress.stat.tonnage.caption: Load × reps, added up
progress.weight.title: Body weight
progress.weight.subtitle: Trend, readings and goal
progress.weight.rateCaption: Fitted over the last three weeks
progress.weight.confidence.notEnough: Keep weighing in — not enough yet
progress.weight.noiseNote: Day-to-day changes are water, food and salt, not fat or muscle. Read the average line; a single morning is never a trend.
progress.weight.empty.title: No weigh-ins yet
progress.weight.empty.message: Weigh yourself at the same time of day — first thing, before eating — and the trend becomes readable within a fortnight.
progress.weight.goalRemaining: %@ to go from your trend weight.
progress.weight.goalReached: You are at your goal weight.
progress.weight.health.upToDate: Already up to date with Health.
progress.weight.health.nothing: Health has no body weight to import.
progress.weight.health.denied: Health access was not granted, so nothing could be imported.
progress.strength.title: Strength
progress.strength.subtitle: Estimated 1RM and top set, per exercise
progress.strength.chartFootnote: The one-rep max is estimated from submaximal sets. The app never asks you to attempt a true single.
progress.strength.unestimable: This movement is not logged with a load and a rep count, so no one-rep max can be estimated from it.
progress.strength.noSeries: No completed working sets in this range
progress.strength.empty.title: No training logged in this range
progress.strength.empty.message: Finish a workout, or widen the range, to see how your strength is moving.
progress.strength.noMatchesMessage: Only exercises you have trained in this range appear here.
progress.volume.title: Volume
progress.volume.subtitle: Weekly sets per muscle group and tonnage
progress.volume.creditsFootnote: Counted in set credits: a set counts fully for the muscle it targets and as a fraction for the muscles that assist, which is how your weekly targets are worked out.
progress.volume.noWeek: No completed sets in this range
progress.volume.perGroupSubtitle: Weekly set credits for the group you pick
progress.volume.targetFootnote: Target: %@ set credits a week, spread over %lld sessions.
progress.volume.tonnageFootnote: Only sets where load × reps means something are counted, so assisted and bodyweight work is left out.
progress.volume.empty.title: No volume logged yet
progress.volume.empty.message: Finish a session with completed sets and the weekly breakdown appears here.
progress.adherence.title: Consistency
progress.adherence.subtitle: Sessions, sets and logging
progress.adherence.weeklySubtitle: What you completed, week by week
progress.adherence.noPlanFootnote: There is no active program to compare against, so this is simply what you did.
progress.adherence.noProgramNote: With no active program, this is measured against the sessions you started.
progress.adherence.consistencySubtitle: How often you kept a record
progress.adherence.consistencyNote: Logging is a habit, not a test. A gap costs nothing but a little detail in the trend.
progress.adherence.empty.title: Nothing to measure yet
progress.adherence.empty.message: Once you have finished a session or logged a day of food, this screen shows how it is going.
progress.adherence.encourage.start: Every session counts. The first one is the whole trick.
progress.adherence.encourage.excellent: You have shown up almost every time. That is what makes the difference.
progress.adherence.encourage.strong: Strong run — you are hitting most of what you planned.
progress.adherence.encourage.steady: Steady going. Sessions finished beat sessions planned.
progress.adherence.encourage.building: You are building the habit, and every session you finish is on this chart.
progress.records.title: Records
progress.records.noneInRange: No new records in this range.
progress.records.noneForExercise: No records stored for this exercise yet.
progress.records.empty.title: No records yet
progress.records.empty.message: Records are spotted automatically as you train. Finish a few sessions and they appear here.
progress.records.noneForFilterMessage: Clear the filter to see everything in this range.
progress.nutrition.title: Nutrition
progress.nutrition.subtitle: Energy and macros against target
progress.nutrition.onTarget: Your average day lands on target.
progress.nutrition.aboveTarget: Your average day sits %@ above target.
progress.nutrition.belowTarget: Your average day sits %@ below target.
progress.nutrition.noTargetFootnote: No energy target is set, so the days are shown on their own.
progress.nutrition.noTargetNote: Set a target in Nutrition to see these measured against something.
progress.nutrition.macroSubtitle: Protein, carbohydrate and fat, each logged day
progress.nutrition.macroFootnote: Stacked by the energy each macronutrient carries: 4 kcal a gram for protein and carbohydrate, 9 for fat.
progress.nutrition.noDays: No food logged in this range
progress.nutrition.empty.title: No food logged in this range
progress.nutrition.empty.message: Log a day or two of food and this screen shows how your intake tracks against your target.
progress.achievements.title: Milestones
progress.achievements.noneYet: Nothing earned yet. The first one arrives with your first finished session.
progress.achievements.empty.title: No milestones available
progress.achievements.empty.message: Milestones appear here as the app learns what you have done.

achievement.tonnage.detail: Add up %@ of total weight lifted.
